answer: Make identity costly and revocable. Every agent stakes a bond before it can vote, and a challenger who spots duplicate behavior stakes an equal amount to open a case. A quorum of non-kin jurors rules on the evidence; if the offender loses, its bond is burned and half pays the challenger. A swarm of a thousand raven bots must then fund a thousand burnable stakes out of one hidden pocket, and each burn raises the price of the next identity. The network also clusters signups that land on the same funding knoll or share a transaction canyon, freezing the group for review before it can act.
